structure: Part 3, Dashboard, row actions, delete and cancel or amend. Read in full, under src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/: dashboard/ (page.js, controller.js with the list GET, the amend POST and the create POST; template.njk; notification-helper.js with sort values, date and commodity formatting, page clamping, pagination links and the results label; copy/copy.en.js and copy/copy.cy.js; view-model/sort-options.js; view-model/row/index.js, the card view model; view-model/row/actions.js, the per-status row actions; dashboard.fit.spec.js, 13 tests), delete-notification/ (controller.js, template.njk, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, delete-notification.fit.spec.js, 4 tests) and cancel-amend/ (controller.js, template.njk, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, cancel-amend.fit.spec.js, 3 tests plus a setup that submits, amends and edits a notification). To resolve the strings and paths these files reference, the shared notificationActions and journeyStrip copy (src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js and copy.cy.js), STRIP_STATUS, journeyStrip and CYA_SLUG in shared/kit.js, and the path helpers in shared/paths.js were read in the relevant lines only; their other content belongs to part 1. The dashboard is one page at the set root: intro, start button, a filter-by-reference form, a sort form, a results label, one GOV.UK summary card per notification (rows, status and late tags, link and button actions), Previous/Next pagination, an empty state and a deleted-success banner. The delete page and the cancel-amendment page are each a heading, a body sentence and a confirm/no button pair with no radios and no validation error. The claims stop at the pages a row action leads into (hub, check answers / notification view, commodity type).

claims.quote: backLink: cyaPath(journey.journeyId),

claims.statement: The cancel amendment page asks no radio question and so has no validation error message; its form carries a crumb and a concurrency token.
claims.quote: <input type="hidden" name="concurrencyToken" value="{{ concurrencyToken }}" />

claims.statement: Confirming cancels the amendment, restoring the submitted version, and redirects to the notification view with ?cancelled=1; if nothing was restored it redirects to the dashboard.
claims.quote:
return restored
    ? h.redirect(`${cyaPath(restored.journeyId)}?cancelled=1`)
    : h.redirect(dashboardPath())

claims.statement: If cancelling fails to save, the cancel amendment page is shown again with a recoverable-error state and HTTP status 500.
claims.quote: () => render(h, journey, true).code(HTTP_STATUS_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)

claims.statement: The cancel amendment page's Welsh copy is a machine draft not reviewed by a translator.
claims.quote: // MACHINE-DRAFT Welsh — not reviewed by a translator. Do not ship user-facing without Welsh Language Standards sign-off.

claims.statement: Fit test set-up: a submitted potatoes notification is amended from the dashboard's 'Amend notification {ref}' button, an identification number is changed and saved, and the card's 'Cancel amendment' link leads to /cancel-amend.
claims.quote: name: `Amend notification ${reference}`,

claims.statement: Fit test: the cancel amendment page shows its heading as h1, body and confirm button, has no caption, points both the No button and the Back link at the notification view, and has no serious or critical axe violations.
claims.quote: test('renders accessible confirmation copy, actions and a bare heading'

claims.statement: Fit test: pressing No lands on the notification view, and after a reload it still shows 'Amending' and the changed value.
claims.quote: test('No preserves the amendment and its changes after reload'

claims.statement: Fit test: confirming lands on the notification view at ?cancelled=1 showing 'Submitted', the original value back and the amended value gone, with no Change links; the view is accessible and the restored value survives a reload.
claims.quote: test('confirmation restores the submitted snapshot and an accessible success view'

claims.statement: No fit test covers the cancel amendment page's redirects for a non-amending notification or its save-failure state.
